fact: The National Statistics Council (CNEST) held its 1st extraordinary plenary on 17 January 2024, chaired by the Minister of Economy and Planning, to review preparations for the 2024 census and the change of national accounts base year.
title: Iª Reunião do Conselho Nacional de Estatística - CNEST, Janeiro 2024
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE) de Angola
